ownerKind.description: storage ownership: campaign, character, or crew

ownerId.description: empty string for campaign ownership; otherwise the UUID of an existing entity of ownerKind

purpose.description: narrative purpose, from the game-setting ClockPurposes list; descriptive only, never auto-resolved

behavior.description: mechanical behavior: bounded clamps at full and discards overflow; rollover carries overflow and re-applies it

rollover.description: overflow segments carried past full; always 0 for bounded clocks

relatedClockIds.description: standalone clock ids for descriptive linked/racing relationships; empty array means none

x-segmentsLeSize.description: Admission rule 2 (clock-taxonomy.mdx §5): segments must not exceed size. Standard JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) cannot compare two numeric properties, so this extension keyword carries the rule; validators that support it (ajv addKeyword, server admission) reject segments > size, others must enforce it at admission.
